decisions.reason: The naval vessel lighting line was a substantial investment in a robust specialist niche, likely tied to long certification and defense procurement cycles, so weak early results can be put down to temporary causes and dropping it would write off sunk engineering costs.

The general interior luminaire line got its own launch page and fits the firm's LED efficiency direction, so the visible commitment and investment favor persisting even though its web prominence fell from its own page to a mention in 2024.

The microprismatic pendant is presented as a flagship and was promoted again in 2024 as a latest release, so the strong public commitment and its central role in the announced direction make dropping it very unlikely.

The marine searchlight line stayed on the website in 2024 while its HMI sibling was dropped, suggesting the firm consolidated its marine searchlight investment into this line and will persist with it as its remaining offering.
